name: Silvermine Mts.
lore: The Silvermine Mountains: Howth and Ardagh and the silver between them - the sheevra fighting the miners for the veins, stones that walk at night, and an old collapse in the south-east that let something out of the deep.

chains.title: The Sheevra Warband
chains.hint: The sheevra are massing at their lake camp below the mines...

stages.name: Clear Sheevra Camp
stages.objective: Clear the sheevra camp
stages.announce: The sheevra war-band musters at its lake camp, silver in every purse. Break it up before it marches on Howth.
stages.success: You have cleared the sheevra camp. Dubhan the Sheevra Chief comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the sheevra camp. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Dubhan the Sheevra Chief
stages.objective: Defeat Dubhan the Sheevra Chief
stages.announce: Dubhan the Sheevra Chief stands at the sheevra camp. Bring friends.
stages.success: Dubhan the Sheevra Chief falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Dubhan the Sheevra Chief slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Sheevra Swordsmans Hold the Road to Howth
stages.objective: Drive the sheevra swordsmans off the road to Howth
stages.announce: With The Sheevra Warband lost, the sheevra swordsmans have spread down onto the road to Howth and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The sheevra swordsmans are gone from the road to Howth. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Aine, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Aine has come out to set the road to Howth right. The sheevra swordsmans are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Howth is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The sheevra swordsmans break and scatter. The road to Howth is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Aine falls, and the sheevra swordsmans take the road back.

chains.title: The Gray Spectres
chains.hint: Cold lights over the Fallen Camp...

stages.name: Protect Brother Cillian
stages.objective: Protect Brother Cillian, who is blessing the miners' cairn
stages.announce: Brother Cillian is blessing the cairn of the miners who died in the collapse. Their spectres are coming for him.
stages.success: "That's done," says Brother Cillian. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Brother Cillian falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear the Fallen Camp
stages.objective: Clear the fallen camp
stages.announce: They came from the fallen camp. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the fallen camp. The Gray Lady of Silvermine comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the fallen camp. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Gray Lady of Silvermine
stages.objective: Defeat the Gray Lady of Silvermine
stages.announce: The Gray Lady of Silvermine stands at the fallen camp. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Gray Lady of Silvermine falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Gray Lady of Silvermine slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Gray Spectres Hold the Mine Road
stages.objective: Drive the gray spectres off the mine road
stages.announce: With The Gray Spectres lost, the gray spectres have spread down onto the mine road and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The gray spectres are gone from the mine road. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Fiona, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Fiona has come out to set the mine road right. The gray spectres are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the mine road is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The gray spectres break and scatter. The mine road is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Fiona falls, and the gray spectres take the road back.

chains.title: The Spraggon Warren
chains.hint: Sentinel Aodh is looking for help in Ardagh.

giver.name: Sentinel Aodh
giver.greet: The spraggons have dug a warren under the west road, and the road is falling in. We're going to collapse it on them. Come with us? Tell me when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Good. Stay close - they will have watchers out. With me!
giver.busy: We've only just come back. Give my people a while to rest, then find me again.

stages.name: The Road to Spraggon Warren
stages.objective: Go with Sentinel Aodh to the spraggon warren
stages.announce: Sentinel Aodh leads the sentinels of Ardagh to the spraggon warren.
stages.success: Sentinel Aodh reaches the spraggon warren. "There they are. Clear them out!"
stages.fail: Sentinel Aodh falls on the road. The others carry the body home.

stages.name: Clear Spraggon Warren
stages.objective: Clear the spraggon warren
stages.announce: Clear the spraggon warren!
stages.success: You have cleared the spraggon warren. Spraggon Chief Nuadh comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the spraggon warren. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Spraggon Chief Nuadh
stages.objective: Defeat Spraggon Chief Nuadh
stages.announce: Spraggon Chief Nuadh stands at the spraggon warren. Bring friends.
stages.success: Spraggon Chief Nuadh falls. Ardagh will hear of this in the taverns tonight.
stages.fail: Spraggon Chief Nuadh slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Spraggonilts Hold the Road to Ardagh
stages.objective: Drive the spraggonilts off the road to Ardagh
stages.announce: With The Spraggon Warren lost, the spraggonilts have spread down onto the road to Ardagh and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The spraggonilts are gone from the road to Ardagh. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Fiona, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Fiona has come out to set the road to Ardagh right. The spraggonilts are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Ardagh is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The spraggonilts break and scatter. The road to Ardagh is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Fiona falls, and the spraggonilts take the road back.

chains.title: The Walking Rocks
chains.hint: Miner Fiach is in trouble in the Stone Fields...

stages.name: Protect Miner Fiach
stages.objective: Protect Miner Fiach, who is clearing the blocked adit
stages.announce: Miner Fiach is digging out the blocked adit, and the rocks of the rockfall have got up to stop him. Keep them off.
stages.success: "That's done," says Miner Fiach. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Miner Fiach falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear Rockfall
stages.objective: Clear the rockfall
stages.announce: They came from the rockfall. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the rockfall. The Grinding Stone comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the rockfall. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Grinding Stone
stages.objective: Defeat the Grinding Stone
stages.announce: The Grinding Stone stands at the rockfall. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Grinding Stone falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Grinding Stone slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Small Walking Rocks Hold the Road to Howth
stages.objective: Drive the small walking rocks off the road to Howth
stages.announce: With The Walking Rocks lost, the small walking rocks have spread down onto the road to Howth and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The small walking rocks are gone from the road to Howth. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Fiona, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Fiona has come out to set the road to Howth right. The small walking rocks are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Howth is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The small walking rocks break and scatter. The road to Howth is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Fiona falls, and the small walking rocks take the road back.

chains.title: The Night the Stones Walk
chains.hint: Grinding and creaking from the Stone Fields after dark...

stages.name: Farmer Lasair's Field
stages.objective: Keep Farmer Lasair alive in her potato field
stages.announce: The small stones are marching out of the Stone Fields onto Howth's potato fields, grinding everything flat. Farmer Lasair won't leave her crop!
stages.success: The stones stop - and one, bigger than the rest, rolls out of the dark.
stages.fail: Farmer Lasair falls, and the stones grind her field to gravel.

stages.name: the Leading Stone
stages.objective: Defeat the Leading Stone
stages.announce: The Leading Stone, an old standing-stone with a sliver of silver glowing in its crack, grinds towards the farm. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Leading Stone cracks open. In its heart: a sliver of pale silver, cold as moonlight. The other stones settle where they stand.
stages.fail: The Leading Stone rolls on, and the field road is theirs.

stages.name: The Stones Hold the Field Road
stages.objective: Drive the walking stones off the field road
stages.announce: The walking stones squat on the field road north of Howth. No cart gets past.
stages.success: The field road is clear.

chains.title: The Moon-Silver Convoy
chains.hint: A sheevra cart is on the road from the mines to the Druid's Hollow...

stages.name: The Cart
stages.objective: Stop the moon-silver cart before it reaches the Druid's Hollow
stages.announce: A sheevra cart heaped with pale moon-silver is rattling south from the mines to the rogue druids. Stop it!
stages.success: The cart goes over and moon-silver spills glowing across the road - and the druid who was waiting for it comes to take it anyway.
stages.fail: The cart rolls into the Druid's Hollow. The rogue druids have their silver.

stages.name: the Broker's Hand
stages.objective: Defeat Fiadhnait, the Broker's Hand
stages.announce: Fiadhnait, a rogue druid with a satchel of blue beads, steps out of the trees. 'That silver is paid for. The Voice in Connacht is waiting.' Bring friends.
stages.success: Fiadhnait falls. Her satchel holds blue-glass beads - the Azure Order's coin - and a note for 'the Voice, in the Wicker Fields'.
stages.fail: Fiadhnait gathers up the silver and slips away south.

chains.title: The Badger Drive
chains.hint: Ardagh's herd is up on the High Pastures, and the badgers are hungry...

stages.name: Ardagh's Herd
stages.objective: Keep Herder Dunlang alive while he drives Ardagh's herd home
stages.announce: Silvermine badgers - big as boars and twice as bad-tempered - are coming down on Ardagh's herd. Herder Dunlang needs a hand!
stages.success: The badgers fall back to their sett - all but one, grey and huge.
stages.fail: Herder Dunlang falls, and the herd scatters over the pastures.

stages.name: Old Greyback
stages.objective: Defeat Old Greyback
stages.announce: Old Greyback, the oldest boar of the High Pastures, comes for the herd himself. Bring friends.
stages.success: Old Greyback lumbers off, beaten. Ardagh eats this winter.
stages.fail: Old Greyback scatters the herd.

chains.title: The Deep Wind
chains.hint: A storm rides off the Heights - and something rides in it...

stages.name: the Storm's Heart
stages.objective: Hunt down the Storm's Heart on the Heights
stages.announce: A cold storm pours off the Heights, and the deamhan aeir ride it. At its heart is something that wants out of the valley. Hunt it down!
stages.success: The Storm's Heart breaks apart into sleet, and the wind drops. The deamhan scatter back to their peaks.
stages.fail: The storm blows itself out, and its heart goes back into the deep.

chains.title: Retake the Silver Mine
chains.hint: The Mine-Wardens are gathering a war band on the mine road.

giver.name: Warden-Sergeant Cass
giver.greet: The sheevra have had our silver long enough. Four at least - bots and all - and when you're ready, say [take back the mine].
giver.reply: Up the mine road! Mind the archers on the spoil heaps - into the huts, and don't stop!
giver.thanks: The mine is Howth's again. The silver's ours.
giver.regret: Fall back to the road! We'll come again.

stages.name: Storm the Huts
stages.objective: Clear the sheevra huts while their archers shoot from the spoil heaps
stages.announce: Into the huts! The sheevra archers are on the spoil heaps - keep moving!
stages.success: The huts are ours. From the main working, a horn - Dergal and his overseer are coming out together.
stages.fail: The war band is driven back down the mine road.

stages.name: Chieftain Dergal
stages.objective: Defeat Chieftain Dergal and Overseer Camlin
stages.announce: Chieftain Dergal comes out of the main working in silver mail, Overseer Camlin at his side with a whip. 'Howth's diggers want their hole back? Come and take it.'
stages.success: Dergal falls, and Camlin with him. The sheevra break for the high pastures. The Silver Mine is Howth's!
stages.fail: Dergal holds his mine. The war band breaks for the road.

chains.title: The Sheevra Come Back
chains.hint: Horns on the high pastures: the sheevra are coming back for their silver.

stages.name: The Mine Gate
stages.objective: Keep Mine-Steward Eoin alive at the mine
stages.announce: Sheevra from every slope! Hold the mine!
stages.success: The first rush breaks - and their war-chief comes up the slope.
stages.fail: The mine is overrun.

stages.name: War-Chief Druimne
stages.objective: Defeat War-Chief Druimne
stages.announce: War-Chief Druimne, Dergal's sister, in her brother's silver: 'Every vein in this mountain is ours. Every one.'
stages.success: Druimne falls. The mine holds - for now.
stages.fail: Druimne takes the mine back for the sheevra.

siege.name: the Silver Mine
siege.open_text: Hear me! The Mine-Wardens say the sheevra can be driven out of the Silver Mine! Warden-Sergeant Cass waits on the mine road for a war band. If no one leads them within the half-hour, they'll go without you.
siege.taken_text: The Silver Mine is Howth's again! The Mine-Wardens are reopening the workings - go and see.
siege.repelled_text: The assault on the Silver Mine has been thrown back. The sheevra grow bolder.
siege.raid_text: The sheevra are coming back for the Silver Mine!
siege.held_text: The sheevra are beaten off. The Silver Mine holds.
siege.fall_text: The Silver Mine has fallen. The sheevra hold the workings again, and Howth must rebuild its resolve.
siege.carry_text: The Mine-Wardens lead you up the mine road at a run.
siege.carried_cry: The war band wouldn't wait any longer - the Mine-Wardens have stormed {0}!

camp_npcs.name: Warden-Quartermaster Ceallach
camp_npcs.greet: Mine-only stock: silver from these very workings, for those who took them back and those who hold them.

camp_npcs.name: Brewer Gobnait
camp_npcs.greet: Miners' brews. Dust in your throat all day, you want something stronger than water. Coin, mind.

camp_npcs.name: Smith Flann
camp_npcs.greet: Sheevra iron. Good stuff, honestly. I'm making horseshoes of it out of spite.
camp_npcs.idle: Ring of the hammer, ring of the pick. Sounds like home.

camp_npcs.name: Mine-Warden
camp_npcs.idle: Keep your eyes on the high pastures. That's where they'll come from.
